title: Companion code for explicit L-infinity stability bounds of undecimated Daubechies smoothers
description:
Numerical and Lean 4 artefacts that reproduce the claims of the companion short note Explicit L-infinity stability bounds for undecimated Daubechies smoothing and wavelet-filtered persistence landscapes (Lincovil Curivil, Reinoso Reinoso, Pacheco-Barrios).

This record is not the paper. It contains no LaTeX manuscript and no PDF. Cite the note itself; use this record to regenerate the numbers, the Lean certificate, and the frozen medical table and figure.

Contents: the Python validation package that produces every number quoted in the note and its frozen CSV outputs; the Lean 4.33.0 development (the Theorem A composition skeleton plus the db2 quadrature-mirror-filter certificate); an autonomous medical kit that rebuilds the 3-panel figure from frozen CSV/JSON only; and the SHA256SUMS manifest.

The chest radiographs used for the medical illustration are not redistributed. The repository carries only the deterministic filename manifest and the scripts needed to process images obtained independently from the original public source (Kermany et al., Cell 172(5):1122-1131, 2018), subject to its access and licensing conditions. The medical results included here are the frozen CSV/JSON outputs used for the note.

Licensed MIT. The medical illustration is an artificial bounded-perturbation illustration, not a clinical validation.
